summary: Adds a signed PostgreSQL schema-epoch bridge whose owner job stops before explicit-context enforcement while application startup verifies either side of the policy cutover.

instructions: Deploy the independently signed bridge release and let its separately credentialed owner job apply exactly through migration 1700000000131 before starting bridge application replicas.

For pooled PostgreSQL, set the chart profile to database.profile.databaseType=postgres and database.profile.tenancyMode=pooled; confirm the existing ledger is exactly the signed 132-entry inventory through migration 1700000000130.

Configure the release-effect cohort with the exact inventory version and SHA-256 projected by this release's signed candidate receipt; the chart orders owner migration, restricted preflight, and cohort opening before workloads.
Keep the bridge and previous qualified release for the complete 28-day fallback interval; only the later owner-controlled release may apply migration 1700000000132.

configuration: The explicit postgres/pooled chart profile activates the signed bridge contract. Other adapters, single-tenancy PostgreSQL, and omitted profiles retain the existing database.migration.enabled behavior.
No operator migration-skip or schema-epoch selector is added. The application verify role and owner migration ceiling are immutable signed manifest data.

notes: The bridge owner entrypoint can execute the already introduced release-effect migration 1700000000131 but filters TypeORM before migration 1700000000132.
The bridge accepts only exact migration-ledger inventories through 1700000000131 with the released legacy policy or through 1700000000132 with attested explicit-context policies.
The owner accepts only the exact 1700000000130 predecessor or an already accepted epoch. Fresh databases and empty or partial ledgers require a separate signed bootstrap/recovery release.

security: Application startup rejects apply mode for pooled PostgreSQL before schema repair, synchronization or connection-owned migration work.

The bounded owner path cannot run synchronize, migration-ledger baselining, policy repair, critical-schema repair, generic grant refresh, RBAC seeding or legacy projection side effects; its optional configured-role action is limited to SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE on the new 0131 cohort table.

The signed candidate receipt binds the manifest checksum, exact minimum/accepted epochs, unsupported bootstrap/recovery states, executable implementation digest, and exact release-effect inventory version/SHA-256; candidate image qualification verifies the same bytes at both backend runtime and published shared-package locations.
knownLimitations: Cloud rollout remains responsible for verifying the signed receipt and exact source/image/chart subjects before selecting the bridge; this OSS release does not implement a provider controller.
rollback: Before migration 1700000000132, restore the preceding qualified runtime while preserving migration 1700000000131 and its additive settlement tables.
After migration 1700000000132, use the qualified pre-upgrade backup and compatible runtime; do not edit the TypeORM ledger or recreate permissive policies in place.
validation: Focused tests prove application apply rejection, the exact owner ceiling, pre-mutation rejection of empty/partial/unexpected owner ledgers, absence of owner repair or policy-lease side effects, exact pre/post ledger acceptance, and exact receipt-bound cohort inventory.

PostgreSQL integration verifies the released legacy policy and restricted cohort grant before the real 1700000000132 enforcement migration and the explicit-context profile afterward; package, Helm and signed-candidate contracts verify immutable manifest delivery.
